source_text: Restituet totum et quintam partem addet. Paenitentia cum restitutione. Non sufficit fletus sine opere.
pass_a_gloss: He-will-restore whole and fifth part will-add. Penitence with restitution. Not suffices weeping without work.
pass_b_english: He shall [[restore the whole and add a fifth >> Bible:Leviticus 6:5]]. Penitence comes with restitution. Tears without deed are not enough.
